description: Deterministic synthetic surf session with exactly known wave intervals. Generated by surf.synthetic.make_synthetic_session. Contains no personal data and no third-party derived values (ADR-0008).

true_track._note: Aggregates of the noiseless track a smoother is scored against.

frame._note: L2's shore frame on the reference session. The generator puts the shore due east, so true_bearing_deg is the answer the estimator has to find. max_error_deg is the tolerance this stage claims; the pinned bearing catches drift far below it.

candidates._note: L3's high-recall proposals. Two numbers, deliberately: recall over every true ride is capped by blindness -- rides that were mostly unobserved leave the smoother nothing to recover -- while recall over rides with at least 50% position coverage measures the rule itself. The second is the one that must stay at 1.0; the first moving is information about the fixture, not necessarily a regression. Precision is recorded and NOT gated: L5 is what tightens it, and a ride never proposed here cannot be recovered later.
